ogTitle: Duvall Tile Installation — Warm Floors, Dry Walls

roles.heroLead: A Duvall winter keeps a bathroom damp from October to May, and grout was never going to hold that back. The bonded membrane behind the tile is the real waterproofing. We slope the base, seal the membrane, let a 24-hour flood test prove the work — on camera — and set tile only after it passes.
roles.costH2: How much does tile installation cost in Duvall, WA?
roles.costP1: In Duvall, tile installation prices out at roughly $14–$26 per installed square foot, covering tile, setting supplies, substrate prep and labor — labor on its own opens at $11/sq ft. A standard surround for a tub or shower falls in the $3,200–$6,800 band, and a full bathroom with shower, floor and niche usually totals $6,500–$14,000.
roles.costP2: The counterintuitive part: what the tile costs matters less than what shape it comes in. Mosaic sheets at $4 can cost more on the wall than $12 large-format porcelain, since the hours go into cuts and grout lines rather than the material.
roles.costNote: Current for Duvall as of August 2026 — tile plus materials plus labor. The free estimate puts the actual number on paper.
roles.layersLead: There are seven layers in a shower built to last, bottom to top. The leaks we get called about around the valley trace back to a skipped layer — usually the membrane — a few-hundred-dollar shortcut that eventually costs ten thousand to undo.
roles.whyP1: The trouble with a shower leak is its patience. It seeps past the grout, soaks into the substrate, and waits a year or two before showing up as a soft floorboard or a bloom on the ceiling underneath. Once it does, you're rebuilding framing, subfloor and drywall before any new tile goes in.
roles.whyP2: Waterproofing is roughly one dollar in ten of a shower's cost — and skipping it is the most expensive decision a bathroom remodel can make.
roles.scopeIntro: Take these as floors, not totals — format, substrate shape and layout complexity all shift them. Your written number comes free with the site visit.
roles.cardShower: Everything under the tile comes first — pre-slope, bonded membrane, flood test — before niche, curb or curbless entry. The invisible work is the work.
roles.cardFloors: Bathrooms, kitchens, mudrooms, entries and basements. The subfloor gets flattened, and an uncoupling membrane goes down anywhere movement or a heat mat demands it.
roles.cardBacksplash: Mosaic sheet, subway, herringbone or slab-look porcelain, with tight outlet cuts and finished edge trim. Grout gets matched to your counter — the tile box doesn't vote.
roles.cardHeated: The valley's favorite upgrade: an electric mat laid over uncoupling membrane, resistance-tested twice — before setting and after — on a dedicated circuit. Only sensible while the floor is open.
roles.cardRepair: Failed grout, a cracked tile, shower corners opening up. We tell you up front whether repair makes sense or the substrate beneath has quietly failed.
roles.cardDemo: Demo means tile, thinset and backer gone, dust sealed off with sheeting and negative air, and the whole mess hauled. Nothing waits in your driveway for spring.
roles.materialsLead: Bad tile choices in Duvall homes are rarely bad tile — they're a good tile asked to live in the wrong room. Here's the two-minute version of our on-site advice.
roles.materialsNote: Prices are for the material by itself, pre-installation. We'll bring samples along and say which ones earn their premium.
roles.estIntro: Rough numbers built from the same four inputs we use on site — scope, footage, tile format and prep. Close enough to plan the winter project around.
roles.daysLead: Most Duvall bathrooms run four to six working days start to finish. The unglamorous middle two are what keep it dry for decades.

roles.faqQ1: How much does tile installation cost in Duvall, WA?
roles.faqA1: Tile installation around Duvall prices at roughly $14 to $26 per square foot installed, covering tile, setting supplies, substrate prep and labor — the labor piece starts at $11 per square foot by itself. A standard tub-shower surround runs from $3,200 up to $6,800, and a complete bathroom — floor, shower, niche — generally finishes between $6,500 and $14,000. The tile's shape moves cost more than its price: mosaics and large-format both eat labor faster than 12×12.
roles.faqQ2: How much does it cost to tile a shower in Duvall?
roles.faqA2: In Duvall, set aside $3,200–$6,800 for an alcove shower of standard size — the figure covers demo, a bonded waterproofing system, a sloped pan, the setting work, a niche and grout. Steam, benches, full-height stone and curbless designs price above that. The waterproofing runs about a tenth of the cost, and it's what prevents the five-figure failure down the road.
roles.faqQ3: Do you waterproof showers before tiling?
roles.faqA3: Yes, and we prove it before tiling. Each shower gets a bonded waterproofing system — pre-sloped base, membrane run wall-high in sheet or liquid form, with corners, seams and pipe penetrations sealed — followed by a 24-hour flood test, documented in photos, before the first tile is set. Neither tile nor grout is waterproof; the membrane is the layer standing between your shower and your framing.
roles.faqQ4: How long does a bathroom tile job take?
roles.faqA4: Four to six working days is the honest answer for a Duvall bathroom: a day of demolition and dust control, a day of substrate and waterproofing plus the 24-hour flood test, one or two days setting tile, and a day of grout, silicone and trim. The grout then cures for 24 hours before the shower runs. A floor on its own is one to two days.
roles.faqQ5: Porcelain or ceramic tile — which is better?
roles.faqA5: Porcelain wins anywhere water or traffic is involved: it's denser, chips less, and absorbs under 0.5% water — a real virtue in a valley bathroom that stays damp half the year. Ceramic is the lighter-duty, lower-cost option and does fine on walls and backsplashes. Porcelain goes on every floor and shower pan we install; ceramic or glass can decorate above.
roles.faqQ6: Can you install a heated tile floor?
roles.faqA6: Gladly — heated tile is the best answer to a dark valley morning. Installed, it adds $11 to $16 per square foot including the thermostat. The mat lays over an uncoupling layer, gets resistance-tested on either side of the tile work, and runs on its own circuit. The only affordable moment to add it is while the floor is open, so it pays to decide early.
roles.faqQ7: Do I need to remove the old tile first?
roles.faqA7: Usually. Old tile out and hauled costs about $3.50 a square foot, and it's the only way to actually see the subfloor — checking for rot and movement, and getting the finished height right where floors meet. Tile-over-tile can succeed on a flat, well-bonded, solid base, but it builds up the floor and keeps problems out of sight until they're expensive. We take it out.
roles.faqQ8: How much does a kitchen backsplash cost in Duvall?
roles.faqA8: $1,100 to $2,200 covers a typical 30 square foot kitchen backsplash in Duvall, installed — outlet cuts, edge trim and color-matched grout included. Cutting time is the swing factor: herringbone layouts, mosaic sheets, picture-frame details behind the range and full-height slab-look porcelain all sit toward the top of that range.
roles.faqQ9: Can you fix cracked tile or regrout instead of replacing?
roles.faqA9: Yes, often. Repair and regrout work starts at $8 per square foot and suits stained or crumbling grout, the odd impact-cracked tile, and shower corners due for silicone in place of grout. When tiles ring hollow, let go in a spreading pattern, or the wall feels spongy, the substrate underneath has failed and a patch only postpones things. We diagnose which situation you have before we write a number.
roles.faqQ10: Which Duvall neighborhoods do you tile?
roles.faqA10: Every part of Duvall — the blocks around Main Street downtown, Big Rock, Cherry Valley, Duvall Highlands and the plats up the hill — plus Lake Marcel, Stillwater, English Hill, Novelty Hill, Redmond Ridge and Cottage Lake. We also tile in Carnation, Monroe, Fall City, Woodinville, Maltby and elsewhere in the Snoqualmie Valley.
roles.faqQ11: What warranty comes with tile installation?
roles.faqA11: OC Flooring warrants tile workmanship for 2 years — a longer window than carpet gets, because tile trouble arrives in year two, not week two. When the full manufacturer waterproofing assembly goes in, that manufacturer's warranty rides along with ours. We photograph both the membrane and the flood test, so if the house ever changes hands, the proof goes with it.
roles.hoodsOut: Not named here? If you're within roughly an hour of Duvall, we'll likely come — mention your location when you book.
